retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, sepia-toned urban composition featuring high-contrast portraits against corrugated metal textures with bold, beveled display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-subject urban portrait set against a weathered, corrugated metal wall. The image uses a warm sepia and ochre color palette with heavy grain and high-contrast shadows. The composition is framed by a slight fisheye distortion, with bold, condensed typography at the top and large, beveled, 3D-effect lettering at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subjects against a textured, industrial background
Warm sepia tones unifying disparate photographic elements
Bold, heavy typography anchoring the top and bottom of the frame
Fisheye lens distortion creating a curved perspective at the edges
coreInvariants: Heavy grain and distressed texture overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures; one standing in a doorway on the left, one seated on the right, both occupying the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, beveled title text at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top condensed text, move down to the subjects, and rest on the heavy bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with texture and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed Sans-Serif and Bold Geometric Sans
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Ultra-condensed, high-waisted, vertical stress.
Bottom text: Extra bold, wide proportions, heavy 3D beveling.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Bottom text features a metallic gradient fill and a thick dark drop shadow to create depth.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-narrow top text and ultra-wide, heavy bottom text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy verticality of the top text.
Provides the sturdy skeleton needed for the beveled bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, sepia-toned urban scene with two men in leather jackets against a corrugated metal wall, applying a heavy grain and fisheye lens effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed dark brown sans-serif text at the top and large, beveled, metallic-gradient bold sans-serif text with a thick black outline at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/ochre?
Does the bottom text have a visible 3D bevel and shadow?
Is the background texture corrugated metal?
Is there a noticeable grain/grunge overlay?

adjustableVariables: Depth of the 3D bevel on text
mustRedesign: Ensure text is not thin or delicate
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast in the sepia tones
Ensure the beveled text looks three-dimensional
Verify the corrugated metal texture is prominent
Confirm the fisheye distortion is present at the edges
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Sepia + Corrugated Texture + Beveled Bold Type + Fisheye Framing
